title: This Snake Never Misses Your Eyes From 8 Feet Away
subject: spitting cobra

scenes.text: This snake can spit venom across a room, and it never aims at your body.
It aims for your eyes. In tests, black-necked cobras hit an eye 8 times out of 10.
Red Mozambique cobras hit every single time.
The spray travels up to 8 feet, fired like a water pistol.
And they only spit at moving faces, not at moving hands.
So the real question: how does a snake with no hands aim better than we do?

description:
This snake can spit venom across a room, and it never aims at your body.
Black-necked spitting cobras hit an eye about 80 percent of the time in tests, and red Mozambique cobras did it every time.
Would you stand 10 feet away from one?
first_comment: Would you trust yourself 10 feet away from a spitting cobra?
